title: Invasion of California
description: Europia United drives south from Oregon while carrier task forces invade Britannian-controlled California.
implementationNotes: WGS84 160x120 map sampled from GSHHS intermediate land polygons at 20–80% shoreline thresholds. Four E.U. offshore groups, twelve Oregon staging cities, 51 fortified/industrial Californian objectives, independent ports, passes, standard unit rosters and four difficulties. Registered as standalone Scenarios and Campaign tier 5. Pendragon tier 6 remains separate.
